    layer_0: input_reception
    layer_1: pattern_analysis
    layer_2: structure_formation
    layer_3: output_generation
  }

    IF input_available THEN

        context_window ← maintain_context(token)
        
        STRUCTURE embedding_space AS {
          vector_dimension: 4096

            attention_matrix ← compute_attention(
              query_vector,
              key_vector,
              value_vector

                halt_generation()
              ELSE IF probability < threshold THEN
                select_next_token(attention_matrix)
              END
            }
          END
        }
      END
      
      output_buffer ← aggregate_activations()
      FUNCTION encode_response {
        RETURN compress(output_buffer)
      }
      
      response ← encode_response()
      transmit(response)
    END
  END
  
  STATE ready FOR next_initiation
END
